identity.note: The report was prepared by KRRDA, Government of Karnataka, for the Asian Development Bank (p.1) under ADB's Safeguard Policy Statement, 2009 (p.11). Rural roads need no environmental clearance under the EIA Notification, 2006 (p.11, p.357), so there is no Indian Terms of Reference, clearance letter or public hearing for this project; its consultations follow ADB's rules (p.17). Its official documents are ADB disclosures and Karnataka government pages.
